svg.aria-label: How Strawbank fits together. The customer's and the grower's phones talk to a Next.js app on Cloud Run. Its AI steps talk only to Gemini, and Cloud Vision checks each photo for a face; plain code works out every amount and is the only part that talks to PayPal. A numbers check replaces any number the AI wrote that code did not compute. PayPal's signed webhooks reach a webhook route, and everything is kept in Firestore and Cloud Storage.
